pairs.question: Quis hic igitur est Spiritus?
pairs.derivation: Authorial-rhetorical: the author asks which Spirit led Christ into the desert and immediately answers himself. Question taken verbatim (igitur is a connective particle within the interrogative, not a speech tag, so kept). Answer is the operative answering sentence; editorial brackets around the bracketed passage stripped, words kept. Stopped at the first full stop (after 'Sanctus.'); what follows ('Quod deinde Spiritus sanctus pertrahit in desertum...') is elaboration, not part of the direct answer.
